pattern.description: A gradient orb contracts, then splits into five rounded pill bars that grow and oscillate in height like an audio equalizer before settling into the voice-waveform mark.
pattern.why_premium: One continuous shape morph (orb to waveform) instead of a cut; grainy gradient colours carry across the morph, and bars overshoot and settle with springy staggered heights that read as speech energy.

build_hint.gsap: Timeline: orb scale 1 -> 0.5 (power2.in, 0.15s); swap to 5 pill bars at orb centre with scaleY 0.2 -> random target heights, then animate each bar's scaleY through 2-3 keyframes (elastic.out(1,0.5) or back.out(1.6)), stagger 0.03s from center; animate gradient background-position for colour drift.
build_hint.remotion: Per bar: height = interpolate(spring({frame: frame - i*1, fps, config: {damping: 10, stiffness: 180, mass: 0.6}}), [0,1], [dotSize, targetHeight_i]); orb scale via spring with damping 20 before the split; width fixed, borderRadius = width/2.

notes: b02 groups three middle elements (dot and two bars) because no per-bar candidate exists; b01 (union) omitted. Pattern could also be 'other' (shape morph into audio bars); logo_resolve chosen as the mark resembles the product's voice-waveform glyph.
